> **Beta of this fork** of [iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy](https://github.com/iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy), built on upstream 2.0.5. Samsung packages: Tizen 6.5–7 (`NuvioTpk65`) and Tizen 8–9 (`NuvioTpk`). It is a pre-release, so installed apps do not auto-update to it: install the `.tpk` by hand (Apps2Samsung).

## Audio and subtitle languages
- **Flags on every source**: audio 🔊 and subtitles, read from what the add-on declares (structured fields such as AIOStreams' `parsedFile`, merged from upstream #487) and from its text (flags, `Languages 🇪🇸 • 🇬🇧`, release names like `SPA.ENG.SUBS`, `CAST.LAT`, `VOSE`, Spanish `Lat-Cast-Ing Subt Forz-Esp-Ing`).
- **Title page**: the audio languages available across all sources, next to the play button.
- **Player**: flags in the audio and subtitle track picker.
- **Source details** (Info): languages spelled out.
- **"Dubbed" filter** follows your audio language and cycles through every language in the list (e.g. only Latin American Spanish).
- **Auto-pick** prefers sources with your audio language, then with your subtitle language.

## Samsung
- No "DV" label or Dolby Vision logo (Samsung TVs have no Dolby Vision); profile 5 sources show a color warning.
- "No sound" warning on DTS/TrueHD-only sources.

## Home and settings
- Add-on name in row titles, and the content type as text or icon.
- New "Label position" setting (Automatic, Below, Inside) and nicer labels below posters (`2026 · Drama · Romance`).
- More space between row titles and cards.
- Animated previews for the new settings.

## Fixes
- Collections: the series tab said "Movies" and loaded movies.
- Title page: the focused play button no longer touches "Play from beginning".
- Animated GIF avatars and collection covers keep their aspect ratio.
